intro:
🏀 REP THE CULTURE. WEAR THE PRIDE. 🔥

MORE THAN BASKETBALL. WE'RE A MOVEMENT.

Represent SouthWestRuns and South West Rise Basketball Club on and off the court!

Our merchandise celebrates basketball, culture, community and unity. Whether you're a player, supporter or part of the SWR family, wear your roots with pride.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

🛒 HOW TO ORDER

1️⃣ CHOOSE YOUR MERCHANDISE

Browse our T-shirts, hoodies and winter hats. Select your preferred size directly on our website.

📏 All merchandise is made to order. Please check your size, colour and design carefully before purchasing.

2️⃣ COMPLETE YOUR PAYMENT

Pay securely through SumUp.

A payment receipt will be emailed to you once your purchase is complete.

3️⃣ EMAIL YOUR ORDER DETAILS

📧 southwestruns.merch@gmail.com

After purchasing, please email your:

• Full name and order reference
• Merchandise purchased, colour and quantity
• Country flag (for Rep Your Flag designs)
• Full shipping address and postcode (if applicable)
• Preferred delivery or collection option

Your clothing size is selected on our website and does not need to be emailed.



━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

🔄 RETURNS & REFUNDS

STANDARD MERCHANDISE

For standard, non-personalised online purchases, you generally have 14 days from receiving your order to cancel, followed by 14 days to return the item.

Return postage is payable by the customer where communicated before purchase, unless the law requires otherwise.

PERSONALISED MERCHANDISE

Genuinely personalised products, including customised Rep Your Flag designs, are generally not eligible for change-of-mind refunds or exchanges.

FAULTY OR INCORRECT ITEMS

If an item is faulty, damaged or not as described, email southwestruns.merch@gmail.com with your order details. We'll provide an appropriate remedy in accordance with UK consumer law.

Your statutory rights remain unaffected.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

📧 ENQUIRIES & BULK ORDERS

For additional quantities, bulk orders, colours, personalisation or general enquiries:

southwestruns.merch@gmail.com

We'll confirm availability, pricing and payment arrangements.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

🛍️ COMING SOON!

Official South West Rise Basketball Club kits, training clothing and more!

💙🧡 SOUTHWESTRUNS | EST. 2019

ONE COMMUNITY. ONE FAMILY. TOGETHER WE RISE. 🏀🔥
note: 🏠 Home Delivery – Include your full delivery address and postcode.  🏀 Free Scrimmage Collection – Let us know if you'd prefer to collect at Harris Academy Merton.  🚗 Local Drop-Off (£5) – Available within 5 miles of Mitcham. Please provide your postcode to confirm eligibility.

items.name: SWR MAP EDITION T-SHIRT
items.description:
SWR MAP EDITION T-SHIRT – REP YOUR AREA. 🏀🔥

SOUTH LONDON BORN. COMMUNITY DRIVEN.

Represent where it all started with the SouthWestRuns Map Edition T-Shirt!

Inspired by the streets, communities and basketball culture of South London, this exclusive design celebrates our roots, our journey and the community that helped build SWR.

Featuring our signature SWR branding alongside a South London-inspired map design, this T-shirt is more than just clothing. It's a statement of pride, identity and belonging.

Whether you're representing Mitcham, Tooting, Croydon, Merton or anywhere across South London, wear your roots with pride.

From the basketball court to the streets, the SWR Map Edition brings together basketball, culture and everyday streetwear.

🗺️ YOUR AREA. YOUR ROOTS. YOUR STORY.
